methods.label: Identify the intercepted major arc
methods.explanation: Point \(C\) lies on the minor arc, so \(\angle ACB\) intercepts the major arc, whose measure is \(360^\circ-100^\circ=260^\circ\). Therefore, \(\angle ACB=260^\circ\div2=130^\circ\).
